Entry.EnglishText: Wonder Chef

Entry.EnglishText: Amnesiac Elder

Entry.EnglishText: Depressed Young Man

Entry.JapaneseText: 陽気なおばさん
Entry.EnglishText: Cheerful Lady

Entry.JapaneseText: 夢多き男の子
Entry.EnglishText: Boy Full of Dreams

Entry.JapaneseText: 微笑む女の子
Entry.EnglishText: Smiling Girl

Entry.JapaneseText: 噂好きなおねえさん
Entry.EnglishText: Gossipy Woman

Entry.JapaneseText: 元気なお年寄り
Entry.EnglishText: Energetic Senior

Entry.JapaneseText: 猫好きのじいさん
Entry.EnglishText: Cat-Loving Old Man

Entry.JapaneseText: 無念の母親
Entry.EnglishText: Grieving Mother

Entry.JapaneseText: 恋に恋する女性
Entry.EnglishText: Woman in Love with Love

Entry.JapaneseText: 腹ペコの少女
Entry.EnglishText: Hungry Girl

Entry.JapaneseText: アルベルト
Entry.EnglishText: Albert

Entry.JapaneseText: 気にかけるお姉さん
Entry.EnglishText: Compassionate Girl

Entry.JapaneseText: 道具屋 猫目
Entry.EnglishText: Item Shop - Cat's Eye

Entry.JapaneseText: 武器屋 ビショップ
Entry.EnglishText: Weapon Shop - Bishop

Entry.JapaneseText: 食材屋 べジット
Entry.EnglishText: Grocery Store - Veggie

Entry.JapaneseText: <Klarth>の家
Entry.EnglishText: <Klarth>'s House

Entry.JapaneseText: ユークリッド村
Entry.EnglishText: Euclid Village

Entry.JapaneseText: 見つけてくれて サンキュー！
Entry.EnglishText: Oh, you found me! Thank you~!

Entry.JapaneseText: ご褒美よ！
Entry.EnglishText: Here, a reward!

Entry.JapaneseText: ……では、サラバっ！！
Entry.EnglishText: ...And with that... Farewell!

Entry.JapaneseText: 知らない…… おまえのことなんて……
Entry.EnglishText: I don't know... Anything about you...

Entry.JapaneseText: 何も……思い出せない……
Entry.EnglishText: I can't...remember...

Entry.JapaneseText: オレは昔のことが、 一切思い出せない
Entry.EnglishText: I can't remember my past at all.

Entry.JapaneseText: 思い出せないまま、 この村にもう十数年……
Entry.EnglishText: I've been here for decades, but what came before that, I still can't remember...

Entry.JapaneseText: 思い出そうとすると、 思い出すなと オレの声がする……
Entry.EnglishText: Whenever I try to remember it, I hear my own voice telling me not to...

Entry.JapaneseText: ここはユークリッド…… 見ての通りの田舎町…… はぁ……もうやだ……
Entry.EnglishText: This is Euclid... As you can see, we're really out in the boonies. Haaa... I'm sick of this place...

Entry.JapaneseText: 俺はこの万年田舎の町で 惰性のまま生き、そして、 骨をうずめるのか……はぁ……
Entry.EnglishText: Am I just gonna let momentum carry me through life, stay in this eternal backwater, and have my bones buried here, too? Ahh...

Entry.JapaneseText: 気の毒ねぇ、村の 奥に住む<Klarth>さん。 奥さんがね～
Entry.EnglishText: I feel so bad for <Klarth>, you know? He's built his life here, but now without his wife here...

Entry.JapaneseText: ……奥に住む奥さん…… ぷっ…… あら……奥さんだったかしら？
Entry.EnglishText: ...His life, his wife... Hehe... Hmm, but wait. Was she actually his wife?

Entry.JapaneseText: <Klarth>さん、奥さんに 捨てられたのよー
Entry.EnglishText: <Klarth> was abandoned by his wife, you know?

Entry.JapaneseText: 何したのかしらね？
Entry.EnglishText: I wonder what he did wrong.

Entry.JapaneseText: 今はやりのDVかしら？
Entry.EnglishText: DV, maybe? Everyone's trying it out these days...

Entry.JapaneseText: DVなんてする人には 見えないのにねぇ
Entry.EnglishText: But he doesn't seem like the type of man to do that.

Entry.JapaneseText: DVってのはもち ドッグバケーション、犬休み
Entry.EnglishText: "DV" is short for "dog vacation," of course. A little rest for your pup.

Entry.JapaneseText: ……わけわかんな～い うける～
Entry.EnglishText: ...Ahahah, of course it's not!

Entry.JapaneseText: 精霊を探してるの？ <Klarth>さん、 また夢見てるのね～
Entry.EnglishText: Looking for spirits? Hehe, <Klarth>'s getting a little delulu again~

Entry.JapaneseText: 本当はそんなもの いやしないのに
Entry.EnglishText: There's no way things like that really exist.

Entry.JapaneseText: 精霊を扱うの、何と言ったかしら、 “だいかんずつ”？ いえ ……ちゅうかん、しょうかん……
Entry.EnglishText: Controlling spirits is... Wait, what did they call it? "Pub minties"? No... Sub man... Sum-mon...

Entry.JapaneseText: そうそう！ “しょうかんずつ”よ！
Entry.EnglishText: That was it! "Summounties"!

Entry.JapaneseText: “少しずつ”と 関係あるのかしら？
Entry.EnglishText: "Mounties"... Does it have something to do with horses?

Entry.JapaneseText: ここ、田舎だけどいい村よ～ ぜひ一度住んでみなさいな
Entry.EnglishText: We may be in the boonies, but this is a nice village. You should try moving here sometime!

Entry.JapaneseText: 身も心ものんびり～ すっきり洗われるわ～
Entry.EnglishText: It's so refreshing~ For both your body and your soul~

Entry.JapaneseText: この村でのんびりすると 社会復帰できないって うちの旦那が言ってたの
Entry.EnglishText: My husband told me, if you just relax in this village, you'll never be a good, productive citizen!

Entry.JapaneseText: 社会復帰って 何かしらね～
Entry.EnglishText: But what even is a "productive citizen," really~?

Entry.JapaneseText: オレの親父は大工だぜ！ この家作ったのも親父だ！
Entry.EnglishText: My pops is a carpenter! And he built this house, too!

Entry.JapaneseText: 親父の跡継いで、この街に でっかい城を建ててやる！ 住むのはもちろんオレだぁ！
Entry.EnglishText: I'm gonna follow in my pops' footsteps, and build a huge castle right in this village! And I'll live in it myself, too!

Entry.JapaneseText: オレは親父の跡を継いで この村にお城を 建ててやる！
Entry.EnglishText: I'm gonna take over for my pops and build a castle in this village!

Entry.JapaneseText: そして、オレは その城に住む王様になる！
Entry.EnglishText: And then I'll be the king who lives in it!

Entry.JapaneseText: オレは大工になって 城建てて王様になる！
Entry.EnglishText: I'm gonna be a carpenter, build a castle, and be a king!

Entry.JapaneseText: ……アレ？ オレ、何に なりたいんだっけ？
Entry.EnglishText: ...Wait, huh? What did I wanna be?

Entry.JapaneseText: オレはこの町を でかくするために 家をいっぱい建てるんだ！
Entry.EnglishText: I'm gonna build a lot of houses and make this town get real big!

Entry.JapaneseText: 道を石畳にして 町のメイン通りに 棚を作るんだ！
Entry.EnglishText: I'll pave the roads and build shelves all along the main street!

Entry.JapaneseText: たくさん家建てても 人がいなきゃ なんにもなんねーよな……
Entry.EnglishText: Even if I build a lotta houses, it doesn't mean anything without people, huh...

Entry.JapaneseText: 空き家だらけの町…… どこからともなく人の声が…… ……うっ、コワい想像しちゃった……
Entry.EnglishText: A town full of empty houses... You can hear a voice, like it's coming from thin air... ...Ugh, now I'm just imagining something scary...

Entry.JapaneseText: トンボ好き～？ あちし好き～
Entry.EnglishText: Do you like dragonflies~? I like'em lots~

Entry.JapaneseText: いいよね～ から揚げがサイコー♪
Entry.EnglishText: This is so nice~ Fried chicken's so good~

Entry.JapaneseText: トンボ～、トンボ～ 羽を取ったら～
Entry.EnglishText: Dragonfly~ Dragonfly~ If I take your wings~

Entry.JapaneseText: ……カマキリさん！！
Entry.EnglishText: ...Mantis!

Entry.JapaneseText: カマキリ～、カマキリ～ 足を取ったら～
Entry.EnglishText: Mantis~ Mantis~ If I take your legs~

Entry.JapaneseText: ……メメズ！！
Entry.EnglishText: ...Earthworm!

Entry.JapaneseText: あちしも トンボになりたいな～
Entry.EnglishText: I wanna be a dragonfly too~

Entry.JapaneseText: トンボになって 大空をとぶのっ！
Entry.EnglishText: If I could be a dragonfly, I could fly through the sky!

Entry.JapaneseText: あちしも トンボになりたいな～
Entry.EnglishText: I wanna be a dragonfly too~

Entry.JapaneseText: トンボになって ばんちょーおーえんすんの！
Entry.Notes: no idea what dragonflies have to do with banchous

Entry.JapaneseText: 知ってる～？ <Klarth>さんって いるでしょ？ あの人、ダオスを 倒した英雄なんですって
Entry.EnglishText: Hey, did you know~? Someone called <Klarth> lives here, right? He's a hero. He defeated Dhaos.

Entry.JapaneseText: え？ 知ってるの？ 見えないよね～人は見かけに よらないっていうか
Entry.EnglishText: Eh? You knew that? I guess you really can't judge a book by its cover~

Entry.JapaneseText: 少し前くらいからかな～ <Klarth>さん、お酒ばっか 飲むようになってね～
Entry.EnglishText: You know, lately~ <Klarth>'s been doing nothing but drinking booze all the time~

Entry.JapaneseText: 村の酒蔵、 全部潰す勢いだって話よ？
Entry.EnglishText: At this rate, maybe he'll drink away all the booze in the village?

Entry.JapaneseText: どうしたんだろうね、 前から気難しいとこ あった人だけど
Entry.EnglishText: I wonder what happened. He's always been a bit of a grouch, but...

Entry.JapaneseText: 最近、ますます 近づきがたい感じよ～？
Entry.EnglishText: Lately, he's getting even harder to approach than usual~?

Entry.JapaneseText: <Klarth>さん 元気になったみたいね～
Entry.EnglishText: Seems like <Klarth> is feeling better~

Entry.JapaneseText: よかったよかった～
Entry.EnglishText: I'm so happy for him~

Entry.JapaneseText: 実はひそかに <Klarth>さんのファン……
Entry.EnglishText: The truth is, I'm secretly a big <Klarth> stan...

Entry.JapaneseText: いつか<Klarth>さんの お手伝いができるよう 召喚術の勉強中……
Entry.EnglishText: I'm studying the summoning artes, so I can maybe help him with his work someday...

Entry.JapaneseText: でも、魔導方程式の 積分法のとこで つまずいてるのよ～
Entry.EnglishText: But I'm struggling a bit with the integration of magical equations~

Entry.JapaneseText: あのミラルドって 年増がいなきゃ いいのに～
Entry.EnglishText: I wish he didn't have a mature woman like Mirald by his side~

Entry.JapaneseText: 助手とか言って ずっとあの家にいるの～ くやし～！
Entry.EnglishText: She calls herself his assistant and gets to live with him just like that~ It's so annoying~!

Entry.JapaneseText: この崖に登れず、かれこれ５０年…… ガキ大将どもになめられ続け、 辛酸を舐めた幼き日々……
Entry.EnglishText: I've spent just about fifty years not bein' able to climb this cliff... The other kids ridiculed me endlessly for it, growin' up...

Entry.JapaneseText: だが今こそ！ 今日こそ！ この崖を制覇してみせる！ 見てろ、あのガキども！
Entry.EnglishText: But right now! This very day! I'm gonna conquer this cliff and show them all!

Entry.JapaneseText: あの崖の上の宝箱…… ガキ大将に取られたワシの 大切なものが入っとるんじゃ！
Entry.EnglishText: The chest on top of that cliff... One of those kids stole my treasure and put it all the way up there!

Entry.JapaneseText: 絶対、取り戻して 崖を制覇するのじゃ！
Entry.EnglishText: So I'm gonna conquer this cliff and take it right back!

Entry.JapaneseText: 崖の上の宝箱は ワシのもんじゃ！ 絶対触るでないぞ！
Entry.EnglishText: The treasure chest up on that cliff is mine! Don't you dare put your hands on it!

Entry.JapaneseText: 見てもいかん！ 見たら目が潰れるぞ！
Entry.EnglishText: Don't even look at it! Look at it and I'll put your eyes out!

Entry.JapaneseText: と、歳には負けん！！ 絶対、いつかこの崖を……
Entry.EnglishText: A-Age won't beat me! Someday, I'm gonna climb this cliff...

Entry.JapaneseText: ……後、５０年あれば 登れるかもの…… …………ほぅ……
Entry.EnglishText: ...If I had another fifty years, I could probably just about do it... ...Hnn...

Entry.JapaneseText: ……なぁ、お願いじゃ ワシの代わりに あの宝箱の中身を……
Entry.EnglishText: ...Hey, could you please go up there and fetch the things outta that chest for me?

Entry.JapaneseText: 取ってきてくれたら おぬしを崖ノボラーとして 認めてやるぞ……？
Entry.EnglishText: If you fetch them for me, I'll acknowledge you as a mighty cliff climber...?

Entry.JapaneseText: タマや～ どこへ行ったのニャ タマや～
Entry.EnglishText: Thomas~ Where'd you go, nya? Thomas~

Entry.JapaneseText: うちの猫が どこか行ったんニャ タマや～
Entry.EnglishText: My cat's gone off somewhere, nya. Thomas~

Entry.JapaneseText: タマや～ シロや、クロや、ザピや、 クィキや、ノシュや～
Entry.EnglishText: Thomas~ Snowball, and Midnight, and Quikie, and Zapi, and Noshe~

Entry.JapaneseText: ラピや、ミュウや～ ああ、みんな どこ行ったんニャ……
Entry.EnglishText: Reppe, and Miu~ Ahh, where'd you all go, nya...

Entry.JapaneseText: タマや～、シロや～ ああ……うちの猫がみんな 出ていってしもうた
Entry.EnglishText: Thomas~ Snowball~ Ahh... All my cats've gone off on their own.

Entry.JapaneseText: ワシは猫がいないと 生きていけんのニャ……
Entry.EnglishText: Without my cats, I can't go on living, nya...

Entry.JapaneseText: うちの猫がみんな 家出してしもうた……
Entry.EnglishText: All my cats've left home...

Entry.JapaneseText: ワシ、 なんか悪いこと、した？
Entry.EnglishText: Did I do something wrong?

Entry.JapaneseText: うちの猫がいなくなったのは うちの犬好きの息子の せいに違いないのニャ
Entry.EnglishText: I'm sure it's my dog-loving son's fault that all my cat's have left, nya.

Entry.JapaneseText: 猫ちゃーん∀
Entry.EnglishText: Kit~ies...!

Entry.JapaneseText: 猫をかわいがりすぎて 息子が嫉妬しおった……
Entry.EnglishText: I shower my cats with too much love, so my son got jealous...

Entry.JapaneseText: それでも！！ ワシは猫の方が好きニャあ！
Entry.EnglishText: But even so! I still love my cats the most, nyaa!

Entry.JapaneseText: ここから北にあったハーメルは 少し前にダオスの部下に 滅ぼされました
Entry.EnglishText: There was a place called Hamel to the north of here, but Dhaos's minions destroyed it not long ago.

Entry.JapaneseText: 私の息子も そこに住んでいたのです
Entry.EnglishText: My son lived there, too.

Entry.JapaneseText: ダオスが憎い…… 私の息子を奪ったダオスが……
Entry.EnglishText: I hate Dhaos... He stole my son from me...

Entry.JapaneseText: ダオスは英雄によって 倒されましたが この無念はまだ晴れません
Entry.EnglishText: Dhaos was defeated by the heroes, but I still want to avenge my son.

Entry.JapaneseText: この村の<Klarth>さんは 時空戦士のひとりです
Entry.EnglishText: <Klarth>, who lives in this village, is one of the Heroes of Time.

Entry.JapaneseText: 息子の仇をとってくれたこと 感謝すべきかもしれません。 でも……
Entry.EnglishText: I should probably be grateful to him, for striking down the man who took my son from me. But...

Entry.JapaneseText: ……できれば 息子の仇は この手でとりたかった……
Entry.EnglishText: ...I wanted to exact vengeance for him myself...

Entry.JapaneseText: 人に任せるのではなく……
Entry.EnglishText: Not leave it to someone else...

Entry.JapaneseText: 私はハーメルへ 行くことにしました
Entry.EnglishText: I decided to go to Hamel.

Entry.JapaneseText: ずっと一緒に住もうと 言ってくれていた 息子のいたハーメルへ
Entry.EnglishText: My son lived there, and always asked me to go and live with him.

Entry.JapaneseText: ずっと意地を張って この村で一人暮らしを 続けてきました
Entry.EnglishText: But I dug in my heels and kept living here, in this village, alone.

Entry.JapaneseText: どうして、息子と一緒に 住むと言って やれなかったのでしょう……
Entry.EnglishText: Why was I never able to just tell him I'd live with him...?

Entry.JapaneseText: この村の貧しい家の娘が ヴェネツィアの豪商の お嫁さんになったんだって
Entry.EnglishText: I heard a girl from this village—from a poor family—married into a wealthy merchant family in Venezia.

Entry.JapaneseText: いつか絶対、 あたしも……！
Entry.EnglishText: Someday, surely, I, too, will...!

Entry.JapaneseText: 玉の輿に乗ったその娘は 今も「虹を掴んだナンシー」って 言われてるわ
Entry.EnglishText: They call that girl who found her knight in shining armor, "Nancy, Catcher of Rainbows."

Entry.JapaneseText: 虹ってのは幸福のしるし、 あたしも虹を掴むの！
Entry.EnglishText: Rainbows are a symbol of happiness! I'll catch one, too!

Entry.JapaneseText: あたしも ステキな白馬の王子様を 捕まえて玉の輿に乗るの
Entry.EnglishText: I'll catch myself a prince charming and become a princess.

Entry.JapaneseText: あなたは…… あっ、ゴメンなさい、 お子様はお断り
Entry.EnglishText: As for you.... Ah, I'm sorry, but you're far too young for me.

Entry.JapaneseText: さっき武器屋で見た男の人は ステキだった……
Entry.EnglishText: The man I just saw at the weapon shop was pretty attractive...

Entry.JapaneseText: 昨日、町の入り口にいた 旅の人も かっこよかったかな……
Entry.EnglishText: And the traveler at the village gates looked pretty fine, too...

Entry.JapaneseText: かっこいい人は服がボロボロ。 お金持ちそうな人は いまいち……
Entry.EnglishText: A fine man wears tattered clothes. Men who look too wealthy aren't very nice...

Entry.JapaneseText: 好みのタイプで お金持ちの人は いないのかしら
Entry.EnglishText: I wonder if there are any rich men who are still my type.

Entry.JapaneseText: 白馬の王子様を探して もう４０年……
Entry.EnglishText: I've been looking for my prince for forty years...

Entry.JapaneseText: あたしも ナンシーになりたいわ……！
Entry.EnglishText: I want to be like Nancy, too...!

Entry.JapaneseText: 知ってる？ チーズINハンバーグ っていう食べ物があるらしいよ
Entry.EnglishText: Have you heard? There's this dish called "cheeseburg steak"...

Entry.JapaneseText: 熱々でとろけちゃうんだって～！！ 一回は味わってみたいな
Entry.EnglishText: I heard the heat makes the cheese all melty~! I need to try it sometime.

Entry.JapaneseText: あの人 どんな目にあったのかな……
Entry.EnglishText: I wonder what happened to him...

Entry.JapaneseText: 学者のとこ行くんだべさ？ もう忘れちまっただか？
Entry.EnglishText: Weren't ya going to meet that scholar? Or what, did ya already forget?
